meaning.en: A person who, or a thing which energizes.
meaning.vi: Một người, hoặc một thứ tràn đầy sinh lực.

sentences.en: Beside being an energizer and tonic, Jatoba has also given very good results in cases of acute and chronic cystitis and prostatitis.

sentences.en: Energizer Vitamins and Minerals for Hair Nutrition provides a complex, nourishing blend of ingredients to encourage hair growth, thickness, fullness and health.

sentences.en: Energizer and Duracell have helpful online guides to finding the right replacement battery.

sentences.en: The Ab Tronic, AB Energizer and Fast Abs were the Commission's first targets.

sentences.en: S., the management consulting firms, have, like the Energizer bunny gone on and on and on.

sentences.en: The triple energizer is one ot the six fu-organs, and among all the zang-fu organs, it is the largest fu-organ in the human body.

sentences.en: ENERGIZER: Oxygen in a Can, All natural energy without the caffeine and chemicals of energy drinks.

sentences.en: Model-C design, with an energizer O-ring beneath the seat-carrier, enables the valve to automatically adjust for seat wear.
